ns2:section.sectionText: There are 3 scheduled online real-time discussion sessions that will be held on TBD at 6:00 p.m. using the Blackboard Collaborate course delivery system (see www.elluminate.com). Students are highly recommended to have high speed internet connection (preferably not wireless), and a headset with microphone for course interaction during the live sessions.
